description: HO NOFA Pipeline is a dataset listed in State of Oregon open data portal (data.oregon.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Oregon. Projects invited to complete Due Diligence. Coverage: Oregon. The portal files it under the category Health & Human Services. The table has 7 columns. The portal shows 2026-06-16 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-oregon-gov-portal.
